# X API v2 Sample Code Repository

> Context file for LLMs and AI coding agents navigating `xdevplatform/samples`.

## Official XDK Packages Used

All primary SDK sample suites use the official first-party **XDK** libraries generated from `https://api.x.com/2/openapi.json`:

| Language | Directory | Package | Install | Run / Typecheck |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3.10+ | `python/` (80 files) | `xdk` (PyPI) | `pip install xdk` | `python posts/search_recent.py` |
| TypeScript (Node 18+ ESM) | `typescript/` (84 files) | `@xdevplatform/xdk` (npm) | `cd typescript && npm install` | `npx tsx posts/search_recent.ts` / `npm run typecheck` |
| JavaScript (Node 18+ CJS) | `javascript/` (84 files) | `@xdevplatform/xdk` (npm) | `cd javascript && npm install` | `node posts/search_recent.js` |
| Java 17+ | `java/` (80 files) | `com.x:xdk` (Maven Central) | `cd java && mvn compile` | `mvn compile exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="posts.SearchRecent"` |
| C# / .NET 8+ | `csharp/` (80 files) | `XDevPlatform.Xdk` (NuGet) | `cd csharp && dotnet build` | `dotnet run -- posts/search_recent` |

Additional community/HTTP samples are available in `ruby/` (58 files) and `r/` (5 files).

## File Naming & Directory Layout

Every XDK language mirrors the same 11 top-level endpoint categories:

- `activity/` — `create_subscription`, `delete_subscription`, `list_subscriptions`, `stream_events`, `update_subscription`
- `compliance/` — `create_jobs`, `download_results`, `get_jobs`, `get_jobs_by_id`, `upload_ids`
- `direct_messages/` — `get_events_by_conversation`, `get_one_to_one_conversation_events`, `get_user_conversation_events`, `post_dm_to_conversation`, `post_group_conversation_dm`, `post_one_to_one_dm`
- `lists/` — `add_member`, `create_list`, `delete_list`, `get_list_by_id`, `get_list_followers`, `get_list_members`, `get_list_posts`, `remove_member`, `update_list`
- `media/` — `upload`, `media_upload_v2`
- `posts/` — `create_post`, `delete_post`, `get_liking_users`, `get_post_by_id`, `get_post_counts_all`, `get_post_counts_recent`, `get_posts_by_ids`, `get_quoted_posts`, `get_reposted_by`, `hide_reply`, `search_all`, `search_recent`
- `spaces/` — `get_spaces_by_ids`, `search_spaces`
- `streams/` — `stream_posts_filtered`, `stream_posts_sample`
- `usage/` — `get_usage`
- `users/` — `get_users_by_usernames`, `get_users_by_usernames_user_context`, `get_users_me`, plus `block/`, `bookmark/`, `follow/`, `like/`, `lists/`, `mute/`, `repost/`, `timeline/`
- `webhooks/` — `delete_webhook`, `list_webhooks`, `register_webhook`, `validate_webhook`, `webhook_server`

Naming conventions per language:
- **Python**: `snake_case.py` (e.g., `python/posts/search_recent.py`)
- **TypeScript**: `snake_case.ts` ESM with strict `tsconfig.json` (e.g., `typescript/posts/search_recent.ts`)
- **JavaScript**: `snake_case.js` CommonJS (e.g., `javascript/posts/search_recent.js`)
- **Java**: `PascalCase.java` with matching package declarations (e.g., `java/posts/SearchRecent.java`, `package posts;`)
- **C#**: `PascalCase.cs` with `Samples.<Category>` namespaces and `SamplesRunner` CLI in `csharp/Program.cs` (e.g., `csharp/posts/SearchRecent.cs`)

## SDK Idioms Across Languages

### 1. Client Initialization (Bearer Token)
- **Python**: `from xdk import Client; client = Client(bearer_token=os.environ["BEARER_TOKEN"])`
- **TypeScript**: `import { Client } from '@xdevplatform/xdk'; const client = new Client({ bearerToken: process.env.BEARER_TOKEN });`
- **JavaScript**: `const { Client } = require('@xdevplatform/xdk'); const client = new Client({ bearerToken: process.env.BEARER_TOKEN });`
- **Java**: `XClient client = new XClient(XClientConfig.builder().bearerToken(bearerToken).build());`
- **C#**: `using var client = new XClient(new XClientOptions { BearerToken = bearerToken });`

### 2. Cursor Pagination
- **Python**: `for page in client.posts.search_recent(query="...", max_results=100): ...`
- **TypeScript / JavaScript**: `const paginator = new PostPaginator(async (token?: string) => client.posts.searchRecent(query, { maxResults: 100, nextToken: token })); for await (const post of paginator) { ... }`
- **Java**: `for (var page : client.posts().searchRecentPages(query, options)) { ... }`
- **C#**: `await foreach (var page in client.Posts.SearchRecentPages(query, options)) { ... }`

### 3. Real-Time Streaming
- **Python**: `for event in client.stream.posts(tweet_fields=["id", "text"]): ...`
- **TypeScript / JavaScript**: `const stream = await client.stream.posts({ tweetFields: ['id', 'text'] }); stream.on('data', console.log);`
- **Java**: `try (var stream = client.stream().posts(options)) { for (var event : stream) { ... } }`
- **C#**: `await using var stream = client.Stream.PostsStream(options); await foreach (var event in stream) { ... }`

## Machine-Readable Index

See `api-index.json` at the repository root for an exact JSON mapping from every sample slug, HTTP method, and `/2/*` endpoint path to the corresponding files across `python`, `typescript`, `javascript`, `java`, `csharp`, `ruby`, and `r`.
